admin.title: Admin console
admin.description: Platform view of workspaces, domains, members, and invitations.
admin.error: Could not load the console. Try again.
admin.membershipLifecycleDescription: Suspending a member immediately blocks access to this workspace and suspends their mailbox grants. Reactivating them does not restore those grants; they must be assigned again explicitly.
admin.suspendMemberDescription: Suspend {member} in {workspace}? Their requests will no longer access this workspace’s data, and their mailbox grants will be suspended.
admin.reactivateMemberDescription: Reactivate {member} in {workspace}? Their mailbox access will not be restored automatically; assign it again in the Mailbox access section.
admin.membershipSuspendedNotice: The member is suspended and their mailbox access has been disabled.
admin.membershipReactivatedNotice: The member is active again. Their mailbox access remains disabled until it is assigned again.
admin.membershipSaveError: The status change did not complete. Refresh the console and try again.
admin.mailboxAccessDescription: Workspace membership does not grant access to its mailboxes. Assign each mailbox separately; the owner always keeps access.
admin.mailboxAccessTruncated: This console shows at most 500 mailboxes, 500 active members, and 5,000 grants. Items beyond these limits cannot be managed here yet.
admin.noMailboxGrants: No members have access to this mailbox.
admin.noActiveMailboxes: No active mailboxes are available for access management.
admin.accessSaveError: The access change did not complete. Refresh the console and try again.
admin.domainVerificationDescription: Add a domain to a workspace, then prove DNS control with a TXT record. Historical domains stay active; new domains remain blocked until verified.
admin.domainAddedNotice: Domain added. Prepare its DNS record to finish verification.
admin.domainAlreadyAdded: This domain is already associated with a workspace.
admin.domainInvalid: Check the domain name and selected workspace.
admin.domainSaveError: The domain could not be added. Refresh the console and try again.
admin.removePendingDomainDescription: Remove {domain} from this workspace? Only pending domains without mailboxes can be removed.
admin.domainRemoveError: The domain could not be removed. It may have changed or now has a mailbox.
admin.dnsRecordDescription: Add this TXT record at your DNS provider. It expires on
admin.dnsCopyError: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
admin.domainChallengeError: Could not prepare the DNS instructions. Refresh the console and try again.
admin.domainDnsNotVisible: The expected TXT record is not visible yet. Check its name and value, then retry after DNS propagation.
admin.domainVerifiedNotice: Domain verified and ready for the next configuration step.
admin.domainChallengeExpired: The DNS challenge expired. Prepare a new TXT record.
admin.domainVerifyError: DNS verification did not complete. Try again in a moment.
admin.invitationDescription: Send a 7-day invite for the Member or Read only role. Mailbox access is assigned separately.
admin.revokeInvitationDescription: The link sent to {email} can no longer be used.
admin.invitationConflict: This address already has workspace access, a suspended membership, or a pending invitation.
admin.invitationSendError: The invitation could not be sent. Check the sending configuration and try again.
admin.invitationRateLimit: The sending limit has been reached. Try again in an hour.
admin.invitationError: The invitation could not be changed. Refresh and try again.
